artworks.title: Two Seated Figures
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two whimsical seated figures. The image shows two stylized figures, one on the left sitting on a chair with a feathered hat, and the other figure on the right sitting with one knee raised, wearing a long coat and wide-brimmed hat. The figures are depicted with simple, clean lines and display a sense of balance and symmetry in their relaxed poses. The drawing is minimally detailed, concentrating on the playful posture and clothing of each figure.

artworks.title: Shepherd and Ruins
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with an oblique perspective focusing on a ruined building dominating the left side. The horizon is low in the image, mostly hidden by the structure. The drawing style features intricate, fine lines creating detailed textures on the building, figures, and surroundings. A figure dressed in loose garments leans on a staff on the right side, observing the scene, with two people walking towards the building in the background, accompanied by small animals. Trees and structures are faintly visible in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background, creating a bold visual impact.

artworks.title: Courtyard of a Farm
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a row of buildings, a person near a tree, a cart, and distant figures engaged in various tasks. The point of view is slightly elevated, with a low horizon. The artwork is sketch-like with fine black lines detailing the structures, foliage, and figures. The scene is rendered in monochrome, predominantly black ink on a light background.

artworks.title: Ponte Vecchio, Florence
artworks.description: The image is an etched depiction from the perspective beneath a large bridge. The composition shows the horizon just under the midpoint of the bridge's arch. Below the bridge, there are figures interacting with a body of water. In the background, there is another arched bridge and buildings along the riverbanks. The etching style uses detailed linear strokes to depict the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, with primarily black and dark brown lines on a light background.

artworks.title: Soldiers Attacking Robbers
artworks.description: The drawing shows multiple figures in a cave. The scene is dynamic, with the figures engaged in various actions. Some are holding swords or tools. The cave opening shows a tree in the background. The detailed line work adds texture to the cave's interior and emphasizes the movement among the figures. The style of the drawing indicates a historical or classical approach to depicting scenes.

artworks.title: The Promenade
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a couple walking together in a pastoral setting. The scene depicts a man and a woman dressed in period clothing, standing side by side, looking into the distance. On the left, there is a large tree with detailed foliage, its branches arching over the couple. In the background, a small town with buildings and trees is visible across a stretch of open land. The delicate and intricate line work lends a sense of gentle elegance to the overall composition.

artworks.title: The Dance
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group in a circle dance. The drawing features eight figures holding hands and forming a circle, engaging in a lively dance. The figures are a mix of human and fantastical characters, depicted with exaggerated features and postures, creating a whimsical and rhythmic scene. The composition captures a sense of movement and harmony within the simplicity of the line drawing, highlighting the dynamic interaction and balance among the figures. The background is minimal, focusing attention on the expressive movement and forms of the figures.

artworks.title: Horses Running
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several horses in various dynamic poses. The artwork features horses depicted in an illustrative and whimsical style. Each horse is positioned in different actions such as rearing, prancing, and galloping. The drawing emphasizes fluidity and movement, with exaggerated flowing manes and tails. The background is minimalistic, highlighting the detailed lines of the horses.

artworks.title: Man Moving Abruptly
artworks.description: Two individuals are shown in profile from head to toe, leaning forward. They wear hats and long, cape-like coats over knee-length pants with stockings and shoes. Their arms are outstretched in front of them. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Violinist
artworks.description: The image features two full-body sketches of a person playing a violin. The person is shown in profile view, facing left in the left sketch and right in the right sketch. They stand with legs slightly apart, holding the violin under their chin and holding a bow. The person's facial features are outlined, and they wear a hat with large plumes, short hair, a structured garment with puffed sleeves, a cinched waist, and a long coat or cape. They wear knee-length trousers with decorative bows at the knees. The footwear appears to be slippers. There is no background, only the texture of the paper.

artworks.title: Peasant with Hat in Hand
artworks.description: The image shows a simple ink sketch of two men in side profile. Both men are walking forward with their right legs lifted. Their facial features are minimally detailed, with elongated faces, noses, and chins. They have short hair and are dressed similarly in knee-length coats, loose clothing, and low shoes. Each figure holds an object resembling a hat in their right hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man Wrapped in His Mantle
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two full-body figures standing side by side. Both figures are striking a similar pose with variations in their stance. Their facial features are not clearly defined due to the angle. They wear hats with feathers, short and curly hair, textured cloaks with fringed edges, breeches ending above the knee, stockings, simple shoes with bows, and are holding canes that reach the ground. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Gentleman with Cane
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length drawings of a person in different poses. The individual is dressed in fashionable attire reminiscent of an earlier era. Both figures are depicted standing in profile and looking in different directions. The person is wearing a feathered hat, a knee-length cloak with fur trim, a cinched doubler, breeches with bows at the knees, heeled shoes, and a ribbon tied at the knee. They hold a slim cane in one hand. The background is minimally detailed, focusing on the figure's fashion and posture.

artworks.title: Man with Sword
artworks.description: This image shows two full-body illustrations of a person from the back. The figure on the left holds a stick and stands slightly turned to the right, with one leg bent and the other supporting their weight. The second figure leans against a flat surface, resting their elbow on it, with one leg crossed over the other. Both figures wear elaborate pointed hats with plumes, puffed sleeves, loosely fitting trousers, and ribbon-like details on their footwear. They have stylized facial features, including a prominent nose and distinct chin seen in profile, and wear draped garments over their shoulders. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Man seen from Behind with His Right Arm Extended
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body illustrations of a person viewed from the back in slightly different poses. The figure stands with one arm extended to the side in a gesturing motion. The hair is styled voluminously, with a decorated hat featuring feathers and a plume. The individual wears historical fashion, including a long, flowing cape, loose-fitting pants gathering at the knees, and shoes with curved toes. A sword hangs at the side. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figure's stylized appearance.

artworks.title: Two Women in Profile
artworks.description: The image features two full-length figures facing each other. On the left, a person with an elegant hairstyle and a feathered hat stands in a flowing gown. On the right, another individual wears a textured brimmed hat and a long coat while holding a cane. The background is simple with no distractions, and the scene is bordered by a thin frame.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6 × 8.8 cm (2 3/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures facing slightly to the side so their profiles are visible. Each person is positioned to one side of the image, looking towards the viewer with a subtle turn of the head. Both figures have distinct facial features with relatively serious expressions and short, neat hair peeking out from beneath wide-brimmed hats. They are donned in long, flowing garments consisting of layered cloaks that create a sense of movement and depth. The clothing details on the right figure are more intricately depicted with fine lines representing the texture and folds of the fabric, particularly on the skirt portion, whereas the left figure's clothing is more simplified. No specific jewelry or objects are visible on either figure. The background is plain and unadorned, with a lightly textured surface suggesting a simple wall or backdrop without particular detail.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length drawings of a person positioned in profile, both facing right. The person in the drawing on the left has short hair partially covered by a hat with a brim. They wear a long, loose-fitting garment with a cloak draped over their shoulders and arms. The drawing on the right mirrors this pose and attire closely. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Front View
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body drawings of the same person in different poses. On the left, the person stands in a relaxed manner, turned slightly to the side, with one arm bent and the other resting on the hilt of a sword. On the right, the person has a more pronounced lean back, both hands resting on the hilt of the sword. The person has angular facial features, curly hair peeking out from underneath a wide-brimmed hat with a tall feather, and is dressed in historically detailed clothing including a long cloak, voluminous breeches, and decorated shoes. They have a sword with a distinctive hilt around their waist. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Front with Hand on Hip
artworks.description: The etching depicts two standing figures in similar poses. Both figures show a person with one hand on their hip and the other holding a sword or stick. The facial features are basic, with a simple expression. The figure wears a large hat with feathers and draped clothing resembling a classical style, including a cloak or toga-like garment and loose-fitting pants. The feet are turned slightly outward. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures wearing cloaks and hats, viewed from the back. The drawing features two outlined figures standing beside each other, each dressed in a flowing cape that reaches down to their thighs, and adorned with decorative bows tied around their legs. They appear to be holding walking sticks or canes. The hats perched upon their heads are round and wide-brimmed, with decorative elements embellishing them. The figure on the left exhibits more intricate linework, suggesting shadows and folds within the cloak, while the right figure is drawn with more minimal lines. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Peasant with a Cup
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body drawings of a person from behind and in profile. Both figures are standing facing slightly to the right, with one holding a long object resembling a staff or walking stick in their left hand and a tankard in the right hand. The facial features are not visible. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat, a long coat belted at the waist, knee-length trousers or leggings, and shoes with visible soles. The left figure's coat has vertical lines suggesting a textured fabric. The figures are set against a plain background.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Side
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body illustrations of the same standing person, posed in a three-quarters turn facing the right side. The person has distinct facial features, curly hair, and wears a hat with feathers. They are adorned with a fur-trimmed cape, knee-length breeches, stockings, and shoes with bows. A sword is visible under the cape. There are no visible jewelry pieces. The illustrations are set against a plain, textured background.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.5 × 8.1 cm (2 3/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaging in a duel. The figures are dressed in historic attire and are poised in a dynamic stance as they engage in combat with swords drawn. Both figures have one foot forward, indicating their readiness to advance or parry. They are attired in period clothing, with detailed hats and puffed sleeves, emphasizing the historical context. The figures are positioned on a textured ground, adding depth to the background. This style of illustration is reminiscent of early modern etchings, capturing the energetic movement and tension of a duel in a singular snapshot.
